title: Synthetic Data Generation Platform with AI Hallucination Detection
summary: A privacy-preserving pipeline that generates synthetic banking transactions from the Kaggle Credit Card Fraud dataset and validates them through a multi-agent LLM system with hierarchical hallucination detection. Its generation step relies on SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (from sdv.single_table), which is imported and run to train on transaction data and produce the synthetic records.
evidence: scripts/verify_setup.py:119-126: 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' trains on 500 sampled rows and generates synthetic records as a smoke test.
needs: Notebooks (01_ctgan_first_pass.ipynb, 02_ctgan_production_500epochs.ipynb) also import CTGANSynthesizer for full 100K-row generation but call sites weren't fully shown; assumed consistent with verify_setup.py usage.
